annotations.title: Compare GPU cards for a task

description: Use for «which GPU should I rent for LLM inference / training / rendering», «RTX 4090 or A100 for my model». Cards suited to one task with their memory (GB, type, bandwidth), the rough model size that fits (FP16 / 4-bit, billions of parameters), and the catalog price of one whole card per hour (minimum, median, hourly-billed plans only) and per month, best value first: inference by the price of 1 GB of VRAM per hour, training and render by the median hour. Weekly figures with their date and the page /gpu/compare.

locale.description: Language of names and page links; also the price currency: ru = RUB, en = USD, de/es/pt = EUR, tr = TRY.

task.description: inference (run ready models, LLMs, Stable Diffusion), training (training and fine-tuning, 40+ GB cards) or render (ray-traced 3D rendering: cards with RT cores).
